== Ingredients ==
* 4 thick cut bone-in [[Cookbook:Pork|pork]] rib chops
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Chop Rub|Chop Rub]]
* [[Cookbook:Cider Vinegar|Cider vinegar]], as needed
* 1 cup red [[Cookbook:Wine|wine]]
* ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], divided

== Procedure ==
#[[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] pork chops generously with cider vinegar. Season pork with chop rub, patting down slightly.
#Bring wine to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] over high heat in a large [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]], and ignite it. Cook until reduced by half. 
#Add butter, 1 tbsp at a time while [[Cookbook:Whisk|whisking]], until all butter has melted.
#[[Cookbook:Grilling|Grill]] pork chops over high heat 2 minutes, brushing with wine mixture, then rotate 90° and cook for 2 minutes, brushing. Flip to the other side and repeat 1 more time.
#Remove and let rest 5 minutes. Serve with remaining wine mixture.
